title: Old Government House, Brisbane

terrainReference.basis: Original terrain just outward from the mapped southeast carriage portico. Threshold grade remains approximate.

mapIdentity.provider: Named OpenStreetMap way 361550693 supplies the original perimeter. Four outer corners register the projecting southeast carriage portico. Queensland heritage entry 600118 and the QUT history identify the property and its sandstone residence and service wing.
mapIdentity.scope: OpenStreetMap way 361550693 fixes the 64-point outline, including both rounded pavilions and the southeast carriage portico. The Qualla photographs establish the open arcades rather than solid lower wings.

note: Two exact public-domain Qualla originals document the early color appearance, published in September 2005. Their exposure dates are unknown. The stone entrance porch, pediment, arched lower verandas and upper railings follow the photographs. The native perimeter anchors the stepped rear service range, covered verandas and two curved wings. Roof arrangement, individual openings, covered courtyard, and height sections are proportional estimates. The 128 m original terrain remains unchanged. The field and porch datum guide foundation and stair levels. The separate campus buildings and grounds are outside this asset. The model uses original geometry and procedural surfaces. No source photograph pixels are included.
